messages:
Maya R: Hey team — onboarding quantized ranker (q-rank-7b-lite). Quick sanity: holdout split B shows NDCG drop only on short queries (<5 tokens). Anyone seen canonicalization mismatch before?
Sam K: Hmm, did we change tokenizer or lowercasing? That's common.
Eli T: Related: when we precompute candidates we run "query_canon = q.strip().lower()" but eval harness might apply punctuation removal. Could be mismatch.
Maya R: Here's eval command i ran:
```bash
python tools/eval_rerank.py --model q-rank-7b-lite --holdout split_b --canon "lower,strip_punct" --batch 128
```
Sam K: Can you paste sample failing query+doc pairs (orig vs canonized)?
Maya R: Sure — short examples:
- "What's AI?" -> "whats ai"
- "Q1: rate?" -> "q1 rate"
Eli T: Also check candidate pipeline: candidate generator may preserve "Q1" tokens as special, so quant version's tokenizer mapping might map punctuation differently leading to KV cache alignment issues.
ci-bot: eval finished for run/4821234567-01 — metrics: NDCG@10: 0.812 -> 0.778 (-3.4 pts), MRR@10: 0.645 -> 0.620 (-2.5 pts) on short-query slice.
Maya R: thanks. plan: run two ablations: (1) force eval to use exact same canonicalizer as prod and (2) regen candidates with same canon. Any objections?
Sam K: also try disabling fastpath quant kernel (just to rule out quant numerical jitter).
Eli T: I'll run regen on a 5k sample and post results.
QA Bot: tagging @maya_r @eli_t — schedule follow-up triage at 11:30 if we don't have clear root cause.
Maya R: ack. uploading quick diff of canon function:
```python
def canon(q):
    return re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "", q.lower()).strip()
```
Sam K: Looks like this removes apostrophes — might collapse "what's" -> "whats", ok. But if candidate indexing used contractions preserved, ranker sees mismatch.
Eli T: update — regen done on 5k sample, preliminary: NDCG@10 on short queries recovered to 0.809 when using unified canon; still slightly lower vs baseline but within noise.
Maya R: Good progress. I'll bucket the rest and run full holdout overnight. Thanks all :coffee:
